decidedBy: project owner, in the Claude Code session that took over the handoff
supersedes: manifest.v1.json policy.actualChatGPTWebRequired for records authored after this date only
rules: Claude writes the prose and scores directly from the unchanged original prompts, style samples, preserved deepAnalysis and stats reference compiled by combined-pilot.mjs.
Claude text is never labelled ChatGPT, never given a chatgpt.com URL, and never paired with invented browser or search evidence.
Every manuscript keeps a search log of the actual WebSearch queries and returned URLs, plus primary-text quotations re-verified against the repository's fixed-revision archive.
Sources seen only through search-result summaries are marked as such; no claim of having read a page that could not be opened.
Author and reviewer are the same agent: source reviews are self-reviews and say so; the owner may spot-check before publication.
Published records keep their original ChatGPT provenance; this policy never authorizes overwriting a published field.
